executive_summary: Rate IBM Overweight and build exposure gradually rather than chase near-term strength. Initiate or add in tranches sized to a moderate overweight, favoring pullbacks toward the 50 SMA / intermediate support, with a stop or reassessment trigger if IBM loses that support, volatility expands further, or free-cash-flow conversion/narrative follow-through deteriorates. Keep position sizes below a full high-conviction Buy because leverage remains meaningful and the long-term chart is still below the 200 SMA. Time horizon is 3-6 months.

AMAT merits a modest overweight, but implementation should be staged rather than chased. Add in increments on pullbacks toward the 430/418 support area, cap initial exposure around the proposed 3-5% portfolio weight, and reassess if cash-flow conversion or order trends weaken. Use a risk stop on a decisive break below the 50-day area near 391, with a 3-6 month horizon tied to continued earnings and AI/advanced-packaging execution.

Overweight NFLX, but build exposure in tranches rather than chase. Start or maintain a moderate 3%–5% position, add on either a reclaim of the 88.5–89.0 area or further weakness that holds key support near 87, and avoid sizing it as a top-conviction position until technicals improve. Use a 3–6 month horizon, with risk controls around a clean break below support and discipline given premium valuation.

Overweight NOW, but build the position gradually in 3%–6% tranches rather than chasing strength. Start with an initial allocation now, add only if NOW sustains its technical repair above recent recovery levels and the next earnings/guidance cycle confirms growth and free-cash-flow durability. Reassess if NOW loses the recovery trend, guidance weakens, AI monetization stalls, or software-sector de-rating reaccelerates. Time horizon is 3–6 months.

Increase exposure to TEAM gradually through tranche-based entries centered near 85 and on pullbacks that hold the mid-80s support/50-day area. Keep sizing at a moderate overweight, below high-conviction max, with a 3-6 month horizon; add only if TEAM reclaims the upper 80s/low 90s with improving momentum, and reduce or pause if it loses mid-80s support decisively.

Increase exposure to INTU gradually in tranches rather than chase an immediate rebound. Start or add with a moderate overweight position, roughly 2-4% initially, and scale only as price action stabilizes; reassess if weakness broadens beyond lower-income DIY tax, assisted/SMB trends soften, or restructuring creates execution slippage. Use the damaged chart as a reason for staggered entries and strict review points, not for full-size aggression, with a medium-term horizon.

Overweight CRM, but build the position gradually rather than chase immediate strength. Start with a partial allocation and add in tranches on pullbacks or if CRM reclaims the 50-day/resistance near 181-183; keep sizing at a medium overweight with a 3-6 month horizon. Risk controls should focus on recent support and on any deterioration in revenue guidance, bookings, or evidence that Agentforce monetization is failing to materialize.

Overweight SNOW with staged accumulation rather than chasing the post-earnings surge. Build toward roughly 1.25x to 1.5x benchmark weight on pullbacks or consolidation, using the 170-172 area and then 165-166 as key support/reference levels; pause adds if SNOW loses the breakout zone or momentum deteriorates. Time horizon is medium term, with more aggressive adding only if SNOW continues to hold above the reclaimed 50-day and starts repairing toward the 200-day.

Maintain PYPL at a moderate position today rather than adding aggressively into a still-broken trend. If initiating or increasing exposure, do so only in small staged tranches—roughly one-third of intended size on weakness—and add only if PYPL reclaims the VWMA/10 EMA and especially the 50 SMA near 46.61 with stable margins and free cash flow. Reassess on a break below the 43.8–44.0 support area or if results show renewed margin compression or free-cash-flow deterioration. Time horizon is medium term, with accumulation contingent on clearer stabilization.

For PLTR, maintain or shift to a modest underweight rather than adding new capital at current levels. Keep position sizing below benchmark at roughly 50-75% of benchmark weight, and for existing holders use strength toward key resistance near the 50-day moving average to trim exposure; avoid chasing until PLTR either offers a materially better entry or reclaims and holds above major trend levels. Key risk is valuation-driven multiple compression if growth moderates, with a 3-6 month evaluation window for trend confirmation.
